newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Far Eastern up sharply at midday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Far Eastern up sharply at midday.

text.p: Taiwan's Far Eastern Textile rose sharply in late trade on Wednesday on confidence about the Far Eastern group's outlook after it recently won a mobile phone operation licence, brokers said.
With 50 minutes left, Far Eastern Textile, a large member of the business group, rose T$1.70 to T$40.10.
A telecommunication joint venture between Far Eastern group and U.S. giant AT&T in January won a lucrative government licence to launch mobile phone operations throughout Taiwan.
"Investors continue to show strong optimism about Far Eastern's future due to its diversification into the telecom industry," said Joe Chiou, analyst for Taiwan Securities Investment.
